content.text: Kopyali kopetame pingi dupwame lao dokopa Anatu kara nange letaminyi.
Nakama peparae kwao piminyisa pilyamo
Nakama kopetame pilyaminyi.
Mendakimipi rolae pyuo kararama lao suu pyaa nalyaminyi.
Kamongome yake dorena piso akali mendemepe
mona palyuo baa kingi wapambupi lakao kingi letamipi lao kando karamo.
Mendakimipi rolae pirama lao ingyapa napala
peparaeme mendare kata palyuo kopetame koo pyuo karaminyi.
Nakama see napala kamenge koo pilyamipi? lao Kamongome pisilyamo.
Koo angi pyuo karaminyi dupwa soo gisa nange wambupi?
Nakamame nambana wambu dupwana bange waa nao karapala
namba lao ateŋa laa nalyaminyi.
Dopa pyuo karaminyipape Anatu doko banya rape rape lenge dupwa keta kararamosa
nakama yamarangurami ingilyamo.
Wambu koo pingi dupwame akali inyimungu karenge dokona mende pinya rapa rapa pingi doko kata rokwalyaminyipape
Kamongo dokome baa kyawa minyingi.
Isaraele wambu mata kyakao nyeramo doko
yuu Sayonepiso epo epena lao ateŋa leto.
Kamongome wambu dupwa dee minyalyaramopa
Isaraele wambu dupwa raeme kumuo pisirami.
